mapper.select: /* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsSbjctList 설 명 : 관리자 콘텐츠 관리 과목 목록 조회 */
/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsSbjctListExcelDown 설 명 : 관리자 콘텐츠 관리 과목 목록 엑셀 다운로드 */

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrWknoContsList 설 명 : 선택 과목 강의주차와 주차별 학습자료 목록 조회 */ SELECT W.SBJCT_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO , W.LCTR_WKNO_CD , W.LCTR_WKNONM , W.LCTR_WKNO_EXPLN , W.LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO , W.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD , W.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD , L.LCTR_ID , L.LCTRNM , L.LCTR_SEQNO , C.LCTR_CONTS_ID , C.CONTS_SEQNO , C.CONTSNM , C.LRN_TOC_TTL , C.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD , C.CONTS_URL , C.CONTS_PATH , C.CONTS_FILE_EXT , C.CONTS_PSTN_CD , C.VDO_MNTS , C.VDO_QLTY_GBNCD , C.ATNDC_RFLTYN , W.SEQ_LRNYN , W.OYN , C.EXRCS_QSTN_ID , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS QC WHERE QC.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID = C.LCTR_CONTS_ID AND QC.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD = 'SDDN_QSTN' AND QC.DELYN = 'N' ) AS SDDN_QSTN_CNT FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C ON C.LCTR_ID = L.LCTR_ID AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID IS NULL AND C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN = 'Y' WHERE W.DELYN = 'N' AND W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ORDER BY W.LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO ASC, L.LCTR_SEQNO ASC, C.CONTS_SEQNO ASC

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrWknoSchdl 설 명 : 강의주차일정 상세 조회 */ SELECT W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , W.SBJCT_ID , W.LCTR_WKNONM , W.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD , W.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD , W.WKNO_ATNDC_RCG_SYMD , W.WKNO_ATNDC_RCG_EYMD FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W WHERE W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = #{lctrWknoSchdlId} AND W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND W.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrConts 설 명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 상세 조회 */ SELECT C.LCTR_CONTS_ID , W.SBJCT_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , S.SBJCT_YR , TRIM(S.SBJCT_SMSTR) AS SBJCT_SMSTR , S.SBJCTNM , C.LCTR_ID , C.CONTS_SEQNO , C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID , C.CONTS_FILE_ID , C.CONTSNM , C.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD , C.CONTS_URL , C.CONTS_PATH , C.CONTS_PSTN_CD , C.CONTS_FILE_EXT , C.VDO_MNTS , C.VDO_QLTY_GBNCD , C.ATNDC_RFLTYN , C.OYN , C.EXRCS_QSTN_ID , C.RGTR_ID , C.REG_DTTM , C.MDFR_ID , C.MOD_DTTM , NVL(RGTR.USERNM, C.RGTR_ID) AS RGTR_NM , NVL(MDFR.USERNM, C.MDFR_ID) AS MDFR_NM , QSTN_BSC.QSTN_TTL AS EXRCS_QSTN_TTL , C.SDDN_QSTN_ID , C.SDDN_QSTN_PLY_SEC , C.LANG_CD , C.HTML_SRC , C.LRN_TOC_TTL , C.LRN_TOC_CTS , C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN , C.DELYN FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER RGTR ON RGTR.USER_ID = C.RGTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER MDFR ON MDFR.USER_ID = C.MDFR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC QSTN_BSC ON QSTN_BSC.EXRCS_SDDN_QSTN_BSC_ID = C.EXRCS_QSTN_ID AND QSTN_BSC.DELYN = 'N' WHERE C.LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId} AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId}

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsUploadContext 설 명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 업로드 컨텍스트 조회 */ SELECT W.SBJCT_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO , W.LCTR_WKNONM , W.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD , W.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD , L.LCTR_ID , S.SBJCT_YR , TRIM(S.SBJCT_SMSTR) AS SBJCT_SMSTR , S.SBJCTNM FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' WHERE W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = #{lctrWknoSchdlId} AND W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND W.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId}
AND L.LCTR_ID = #{lctrId}

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsChildren 설 명 : 관리자 학습목차 하위 콘텐츠 목록 조회 */ SELECT C.LCTR_CONTS_ID , C.LCTR_ID , C.CONTS_SEQNO , C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID , C.CONTS_FILE_ID , C.CONTSNM , C.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD , C.CONTS_URL , C.CONTS_PATH , C.CONTS_PSTN_CD , C.CONTS_FILE_EXT , C.VDO_MNTS , C.VDO_QLTY_GBNCD , C.ATNDC_RFLTYN , C.OYN , C.EXRCS_QSTN_ID , C.SDDN_QSTN_ID , C.SDDN_QSTN_PLY_SEC , C.LANG_CD , C.HTML_SRC , C.LRN_TOC_TTL , C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN , C.DELYN FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C WHERE C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId} AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ) ORDER BY C.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD, C.CONTS_SEQNO, C.REG_DTTM

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsWeekList 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 주차 콘텐츠 목록 조회 */ SELECT C.LCTR_CONTS_ID , C.LCTR_ID , C.CONTS_SEQNO , C.CONTSNM , C.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD , C.LRN_TOC_TTL , C.EXRCS_QSTN_ID FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = #{lctrWknoSchdlId} AND W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID IS NULL AND C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN = 'Y' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ORDER BY C.CONTS_SEQNO ASC, C.REG_DTTM ASC

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsDvclasList 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 분반 목록 조회 */ WITH BASE AS ( SELECT S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , S.CRCLMN_NO , SC.ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.DELYN = 'N' AND S.USEYN = 'Y' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ) SELECT S.SBJCT_ID , S.SBJCTNM , S.DVCLAS_NO FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN BASE B ON B.ORG_ID = SC.ORG_ID AND B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND B.CRCLMN_NO = S.CRCLMN_NO WHERE S.DELYN = 'N' AND S.USEYN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' WHERE W.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND W.LCTR_WKNO = #{lctrWkno} AND W.DELYN = 'N' ) ORDER BY S.DVCLAS_NO

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsDvclasTargetList 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 분반 대상 주차 보유 목록 조회 */ WITH BASE AS ( SELECT S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , S.CRCLMN_NO , SC.ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.DELYN = 'N' AND S.USEYN = 'Y' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ) SELECT S.SBJCT_ID , S.SBJCTNM , S.DVCLAS_NO , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' WHERE W.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND W.LCTR_WKNO = #{lctrWkno} AND W.DELYN = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS WKNO_SCHDL_YN , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' WHERE W.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND W.LCTR_WKNO = #{lctrWkno} AND W.DELYN = 'N' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS REGIST_YN FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN BASE B ON B.ORG_ID = SC.ORG_ID AND B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND B.CRCLMN_NO = S.CRCLMN_NO WHERE S.DELYN = 'N' AND S.USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.DVCLAS_NO

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsTargetLctr 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 분반 대상 강의 조회 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT W.SBJCT_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , W.LCTR_WKNO , L.LCTR_ID FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' WHERE W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND W.LCTR_WKNO = #{lctrWkno} AND W.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ORDER BY L.LCTR_SEQNO ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : ContsDAO.increaseAdmLctrContsSeqnoForInsert 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 등록 순번 보정 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C SET C.CONTS_SEQNO = C.CONTS_SEQNO + 1 , C.MDFR_ID = NVL(#{mdfrId}, #{rgtrId}) , C.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE C.CONTS_SEQNO >= #{contsSeqno} AND C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID IS NULL AND C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN = 'Y' AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = #{lctrWknoSchdlId} AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.increaseAdmLctrContsSeqnoForMoveUp 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 상위 이동 순번 보정 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C SET C.CONTS_SEQNO = C.CONTS_SEQNO + 1 , C.MDFR_ID = NVL(#{mdfrId}, #{rgtrId}) , C.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE C.LCTR_CONTS_ID != #{lctrContsId} AND C.CONTS_SEQNO >= #{contsSeqno} AND C.CONTS_SEQNO < #{prevContsSeqno} AND C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID IS NULL AND C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN = 'Y' AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = #{lctrWknoSchdlId} AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.decreaseAdmLctrContsSeqnoForMoveDown 설명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 하위 이동 순번 보정 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C SET C.CONTS_SEQNO = C.CONTS_SEQNO - 1 , C.MDFR_ID = NVL(#{mdfrId}, #{rgtrId}) , C.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE C.LCTR_CONTS_ID != #{lctrContsId} AND C.CONTS_SEQNO > #{prevContsSeqno} AND C.CONTS_SEQNO <= #{contsSeqno} AND C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID IS NULL AND C.ADM_REG_CONTSYN = 'Y' AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = #{lctrWknoSchdlId} AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : ContsDAO.selectAdmLctrContsLearningHistoryCnt 설 명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠 학습 이력 건수 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS_LRN_HSTRY H WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C WHERE H.LCTR_CONTS_ID = C.LCTR_CONTS_ID AND (C.LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId} OR C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId}) AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ) )
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : ContsDAO.deleteAdmLctrContsTree 설 명 : 관리자 학습목차 콘텐츠와 하위 콘텐츠 삭제 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C SET C.DELYN = 'Y' , C.OYN = 'N' , C.MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , C.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE (C.LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId} OR C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId}) AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )

/* SQL ID : ContsDAO.deleteAdmLctrContsSddnQstnChildren 설 명 : 관리자 학습목차 돌발퀴즈 하위 콘텐츠 삭제 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C SET C.DELYN = 'Y' , C.OYN = 'N' , C.MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , C.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE C.UP_LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{lctrContsId} AND C.LCTR_CONTS_TYCD = 'SDDN_QSTN' AND C.DELYN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_LCTR L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND W.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = W.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND L.DELYN = 'N' AND SC.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )
